additional_info.subject: Customer Query
additional_info.body:
Hello everyone,
Our customer MTB has a question about the charging station's consumption.
It seems very high to him. Could you please comment on this and put the numbers into context? For example, where the consumption comes from. We understand that the heating is on in winter, but
over 1000 kWh per quarter also seems a bit high to me. Only the charging station is connected to the measuring point. The amount at Energu is the amount that was charged and detected via the backend.
Weilerwärme is the electricity provider.
Energu Weilerwärme Deviation in %
Q3-24 7,203.637 7,417.090 2.96
Q4-24 12,686.056 13,593.050 7.15
Q1-25 12,677.498 13,739.870 8.38
Thank you in advance.

Dear Michael Hentzschel,
Thank you for your query regarding the charging station's energy consumption.
We’ve reviewed the data, and the charger is functioning normally. The system is designed to flag any issues, and no warnings or faults have been reported. The higher consumption in winter is likely due to heating and seasonal usage patterns. The slight deviation between Energu and Weilerwärme readings is within expected limits.
If you have any further questions or need additional details, please don’t hesitate to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita
